# IR vocabulary cardinality

The IR must define exactly 10 entity types and exactly 11 relation types, and any types classified as LLM_DERIVED_TYPES must be a subset of ENTITY_TYPES.

Lock the IR vocabulary to the documented spec to prevent silent divergence between implemented types and the spec relied upon by tooling.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_smoke.py` — `tests.test_smoke.test_vocabulary_matches_ir_spec`
